name: draft_message
title: Draft message
description: Save a message as a DRAFT for a person to read and send (an e-mail address or a Slack handle like @emma). Nothing is sent. Use it for anything a background agent would say to a supplier.

ref.description: optional document it is about, e.g. PO/2026/01139

ok.description: true when it worked; false comes with error and next_step

sent.description: always false: a person sends it

example.subject: Late order PO/2026/01139
example.text: Hello, our order PO/2026/01139 was due on 9 Oct 2026. When will it arrive?

policy.on_lost_write_reply: never resent blindly: look the document up (by the supplier's number or its id) and return it
policy.on_busy_before_write: ok=false with next_step; nothing was saved, so the same call is safe to repeat

release_notes.1.0: 12 Nov 2026: Lecture 5 (The Habits): accounts payable and the background agents' watch lists.
